Remove the stored credential of the profile

Remove the stored credential of the selected profile.

A login session is also ended on the server. An access token has no server
session: it is only forgotten here and stays valid until you revoke it in the
panel. The local credential is removed even when the server cannot be reached.

While REPSY_TOKEN is set, logout is refused: that variable is not a stored
credential, unset it instead.

```
rp auth logout
```
